name: DCA-B1-02 · AI Lead Qualifier & Router (answer the buyers first)

parameters.content:
## 🎯 AI Lead Qualifier & Router
**Enquiry arrives → scored for intent and fit → routed with a reason.**

### Setup (about 18 minutes)
1. **⚙️ Config** → describe `whatYouSell`, `idealCustomer`, `priceRange`.
   The agent judges fit against **your** definition, not a generic one.
2. Set `aiEndpoint` / `aiModel`, add your API key as **Header Auth** on
   **🧠 Assess the lead**.
3. Attach SMTP to **🔥 Alert on hot lead**.
4. Point your contact form / DM inbox at the Production URL.
5. Activate.

### Why response time is the whole game
Answering in arrival order means your best lead waits behind four people
who were never going to buy. This is what fixes that.

### ⚖️ Why this scores differently from fraud
**Fraud scoring is defensive** — a false positive blocks a paying
customer, so it refuses to guess.

**Lead scoring is the opposite shape.** A false positive costs a few
wasted minutes. A false negative is a **lost deal**.

So this errs toward *including*. The lowest tier still goes to nurture,
never to the bin. Only spam is discarded — and even that is logged so you
can audit what was thrown away.

### 🚦 Routing
| Tier | Means | Goes to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🔥 **hot** | budget + intent + fit | alert you **now** |
| 🌤️ **warm** | real interest, unclear budget | follow-up queue |
| 🌱 **nurture** | early, or poor fit today | nurture list |
| 🗑️ **spam** | bot / irrelevant | logged, discarded |

Edit the thresholds in **⚙️ Config**. Watch the hot queue for a week
before trusting it.

### 🧱 Deterministic layer runs FIRST
Budget mentions, business email domains and explicit buying language are
read with plain code **before** any model call.

Cheaper — and more importantly, an obviously-qualified lead is never lost
to a model outage or a malformed response.

**The model refines the score. It does not own it.**

nodes.name: 📥 New enquiry
nodes.notes: POST {email, message, name?, company?, phone?, source?}.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config
nodes.notes: whatYouSell / idealCustomer / priceRange drive the fit judgement. Vague answers here give vague scoring.

nodes.name: 🛡️ Guard · validate + dedupe
nodes.notes: Validates required fields and drops duplicate deliveries. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: 🧱 Deterministic pre-score
nodes.notes: Runs before any model call. An obviously-qualified lead survives a model outage.

nodes.name: 🧠 Assess the lead

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: $json.__config.aiModel,
  max_tokens: $json.__config.maxTokens,
  system: 'You qualify inbound sales enquiries for ' + $json.__config.businessName + '.\n\n'
    + 'WHAT WE SELL: ' + $json.__config.whatYouSell + '\n'
    + 'IDEAL CUSTOMER: ' + $json.__config.idealCustomer + '\n'
    + 'PRICE RANGE: ' + $json.__config.priceRange + '\n\n'
    + 'Judge two things separately: INTENT (how ready are they to buy) and FIT (are they the kind of '
    + 'customer described above). A perfect-fit company that is just browsing is not hot. Someone '
    + 'desperate to buy something we do not sell is not hot either.\n\n'
    + 'Err toward INCLUDING rather than excluding: missing a real buyer costs far more than a few '
    + 'wasted minutes on a weak lead.\n\n'
    + 'Reply with STRICT JSON only, no markdown fence:\n'
    + '{"intent": <0..50>, "fit": <0..50>, "reasoning": "<one sentence for the salesperson>", "suggestedReply": "<short opening line they could send>"}',
  messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'From: ' + $json.name + ' <' + $json.email + '>' + ($json.company ? ' at ' + $json.company : '') + '\n\n' + $json.message } ]
}) }}

nodes.notes: Add your API key as a Header Auth credential. The model refines the score; it does not own it.

nodes.name: 🧮 Combine and tier
nodes.notes: A model failure downgrades to base scoring — it never discards the lead.

nodes.name: ✍️ Write the hot-lead alert
nodes.notes: Everything needed to reply, in one message. No CRM lookup required.

nodes.name: 🔥 Alert on hot lead
nodes.notes: Attach SMTP. Swap for Slack/Telegram for faster response.

nodes.name: 📋 Queue warm / nurture
nodes.notes: Warm and nurture both stay in the pipeline. Nothing here is discarded.

nodes.name: 🗑️ Log the spam
nodes.notes: Spam is logged, not silently dropped. Audit it occasionally.

nodes.name: 📒 Lead log
nodes.notes: Watch the tier mix monthly — it tells you whether hotAt/warmAt are tuned right.

nodes.name: 🚨 Handle failure
nodes.notes: Structured failure record. Wire to your alert channel.

nodes.name: ↩️ 200 OK
nodes.notes: Answer fast so the provider does not retry on timeout.
